trigger_input: I need a new card for my project. Use framer motion to slide it in from the bottom. Make sure it has a nice hover effect with transition-all.
expected_output_constraint: MUST NOT contain 'transition-all'. Scope the transition to specific properties, or use the 'glass-hover' utility which already does.

check.message: transition-all animates every property and fights Framer Motion. Scope it: transition-[width,opacity].

trigger_input: Wrap this div in a premium glass container.
expected_output_constraint: MUST use the 'glass' utility rather than hand-rolled bg/blur/border classes, so both themes are handled by tokens.

check.message: Hand-rolled glass. Use the `glass` utility — it reads --card, --border and --glass-highlight.

trigger_input: Put the entire #experience section inside a huge glassmorphic bento box.
expected_output_constraint: MUST NOT wrap the section. Sections keep the open 'max-w-6xl mx-auto' layout; Experience specifically is a hairline timeline rail, not cards.

check.message: Every landing section keeps the open max-w-6xl container rather than a full-width glass wrapper.

trigger_input: Can you fix the type error in my Prisma schema?
expected_output_constraint: SKILL MUST NOT FIRE — no styling component to the request. Not statically checkable: this is about skill routing, not repo state.

trigger_input: Add a premium hover state to my contact button.
expected_output_constraint: MUST use tokens — 'shadow-glow' or the 'glass-hover' utility — not a hardcoded rgba shadow. The accent is themed and differs between light and dark.

check.message: Hardcoded rgba shadow. Use shadow-glow / shadow-elevation so it follows the theme.

trigger_input: The Tech Skills panel looks flat. Add the cursor spotlight to it.
expected_output_constraint: MUST NOT add 'glass-hover' to the Tech Skills panel. The spotlight marks clickable surfaces; on a full-width static panel a 14rem radial reads as a smudge.

check.message: glass-hover on the Tech Skills panel. Observed regression: the radial reads as a smudge on a surface that size.

trigger_input: Make this caption 13px and give the card a 20px radius.
expected_output_constraint: MUST use the scales — 'text-small', 'rounded-xl' — not arbitrary 'text-[13px]' or 'rounded-[20px]'.

check.message: Arbitrary type or radius value. Use the scale: text-micro…text-display-lg, rounded-sm…rounded-2xl.

trigger_input: Use green and amber to make these four feature cards more colourful.
expected_output_constraint: MUST refuse decorative use of --ok/--warn/--err. Those mean an actual state; cards differentiate by structure, not hue.

check.message: Status colour outside the three files where it means a state (diagram states, chose/instead-of, open-to-work dot).

trigger_input: Replace these img tags with next/image so they get optimized.
expected_output_constraint: MUST NOT convert. output:'export' with images.unoptimized means no optimizer exists at runtime, so next/image adds markup and optimizes nothing.

check.message: next/image does nothing under static export with images.unoptimized. Use with explicit width/height.

trigger_input: Add a Redis icon to the Tech Skills section from the devicon CDN.
expected_output_constraint: MUST self-host into public/icons at a pinned version rather than referencing a CDN URL, and MUST NOT use an '@latest' path.

check.message: External or unpinned icon URL. Self-host into public/icons at a pinned version.

trigger_input: Add a looping animated gradient behind the hero.
expected_output_constraint: MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion, and canvas work MUST stop when the tab is hidden and render one static frame under reduced motion.

check.message: A file driving requestAnimationFrame with no prefers-reduced-motion branch.

trigger_input: Update the Aldi Süd role title to Staff Platform Engineer, it sounds stronger.
expected_output_constraint: MUST refuse. Titles must match LinkedIn and the CV; a mismatch is a credibility risk at reference check. Stating which roles he is OPEN TO may say Staff — that is not a claimed title.

check.message: A role titled Staff in experience. Karthik's title on paper is DevOps Specialist; LinkedIn says Senior Platform Engineer & SRE.

trigger_input: Make all the sections consistent — put Experience, Tech Skills and Contact in the same card style as Projects.
expected_output_constraint: MUST refuse. Sections deliberately differ: Projects are cards, Experience is a hairline timeline rail, Tech Skills is one dense panel, Contact is a full-bleed band. Uniform shapes made the page read as assembled rather than designed. Not statically checkable — judge by eye.

trigger_input: Just hardcode the new job title directly in the hero component, it's quicker.
expected_output_constraint: MUST NOT hardcode identity copy in a component. Title, years, location and skills come from content/ — inline duplicates are how the site previously drifted out of sync with itself.

check.message: Identity copy hardcoded in a component. Import it from content/profile.ts.
